scripts.dev: pnpm wasm && pnpm refs:model && (REF_ADMIN=1 cargo run -q --release -p pencilpilot-ref-service & pnpm --filter @pencilpilot/web dev)
scripts.test: pnpm --filter './packages/*' --filter @pencilpilot/studio test && pnpm --filter @pencilpilot/web test:unit -- --run && pnpm --filter @pencilpilot/director-server test
scripts.wasm:grader: wasm-pack build crates/grader-wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name grader
scripts.wasm:brush: wasm-pack build crates/brush-wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name brush
